_about: Role 4 evidence for data/spots_tokyo.json. Spot cannot carry sources or allergens, so they live here. allergens = known present (blocks a member with that allergy). allergenFree = verified absent (only from the venue). Missing = unknown: not blocked, the member is reminded privately. Sources read on 2026-11-09.

meiji.note: Naien grounds only; museum and inner garden excluded.

miraikan.note: Adult regular admission; dome and special exhibits excluded.

zojoji.note: Grounds only. Check separate hours and fees for inner facilities.

senso_ji.note: Standard visit; paid items and services excluded.

ueno_park.note: Park grounds only; museums and zoo separate.

yoyogi_park.note: Park grounds only. Special facilities excluded.

ts_tantan.note: One Golden Sesame bowl, no sides. Contains sesame. Plant-based per operator. Tokyo Station/Gransta complex pin, not an indoor navigation point. Source lists 10:00-22:00; dataset says 07:00-22:30 (to fix in spots_tokyo.json).

imperial_east.note: Garden admission only. Palace tours have separate access.

nmwa.note: Adult permanent collection; see museum admission guide.

ameyoko.note: Vendors set prices and hours. Dietary evidence needed for a named vendor and dish. Dataset price is a rough per-person estimate; vendors vary.

tsukiji.note: Individual vendor prices, hours and diet vary. Dataset price is a rough per-person estimate; vendors vary.

ain_soph.note: Plant-based operator menu. Date, meal and allergy handling must be confirmed.
